reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: Was using the app for maybe four months and about a month ago the app just stopped opening. I figured I’d wait it out a bit to see if they came out with an update to fix whatever is going on but I guess they aren’t going to since I haven’t seen any available updates when I check. Welp it’s been a month and still won’t even open so I guess it’s time to delete the app.

reviews.title: Insensitive Company
reviews.text: *BEWARE* if you so happen to have a miscarriage and lose your baby, it is apparently impossible to delete your account, and even when you reach out and fill out their silly little form, they continue to send you painful emails to remind you of the baby you lost. 💔 EXTREMELY insensitive company!!!

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: I like the content, but the app keeps freezing and quitting spontaneously. I have to restart it lime a million times. Please fix!

reviews.title: Freezes a lot
reviews.text: I love the information the app provides about each week of pregnancy but it freezes almost every time I open it. I have to continuously force close and try again but it still doesn’t work. Ended up just uninstalling.

reviews.title: Worked great until it didn’t
reviews.text: Randomly logged me out every few weeks, now today I’m logged out and my account didn’t exist? So now it’s useless unless I make another account. Thanks but no thanks

reviews.title: Logged me out twice now and have to restart
reviews.text: I’ve always used another app to track my pregnancy and tried this new one and the experience is horrible. All my names saved, kicks counted disappeared. Very upsetting and disappointing

reviews.title: Annoying
reviews.text: I got this app and thought it was helpful to have while tracking my pregnancy. Until I clicked on an article that discussed learning about the gender of the baby. Within the article it had a whole paragraph describing how gender and sex are different terms. Which, is not biologically true nor was this ever true. This type of agenda should not be pushed within articles on pregnancy tracking apps. The sex of your baby is male or female and that is also the gender of your baby as well. Nobody should be writing articles pushing false information to other people. Thank goodness I have my head screwed on right and know that if my baby is born a boy, he's always a boy. And if it's a girl, she's always a girl. Will be contacting the app to express concerns about the articles they feature on their app.

reviews.title: Another couple’s info populated in my account
reviews.text: I just downloaded this app a few days ago and didn’t spend too much time looking around until today. I noticed that the initial in the top right corner that indicates the user’s name didn’t match my first name, so I went into the account details. Another person’s full name (not in any way related to my own) is in the “My Account” fields, and another full name (also in no way similar to my name) is shown under “My Significant Other.” The address in the account is my address from 10+ years ago. I searched for the couples’ names and they are in fact a real couple who live in the same state as the address shown in the account. It’s possible they lived in the house at one point but is unlikely because I am the third owner (still own it), and I don’t think any of the previous owners rented it out. I am THOROUGHLY creeped out and want to know how this happened. Is my information now showing up in someone else’s account? This seems like a MASSIVE breach of privacy.

reviews.title: Glitches & Inaccuracy
reviews.text: It will glitch often and you’ll be stuck at the Home Screen. Also refers to breast feeding as “chest feeding” and calls us women “pregnant people”

reviews.title: Need to fix
reviews.text:
The app keeps logging me out, which is really frustrating.
Also all the journals  disappeared when it upgraded automatically and no where to be found.

reviews.title: Not good anymore
reviews.text: Feels like the developers and owners abandoned it or something. A bunch of features are buggy or don’t work at all (like the 3D models), I’m regularly logged out and have to find my login info. It doesn’t update unless I force a restart, so I regularly open the app and get the wrong number of weeks which is the #1 thing the app is supposed to do: say how far along we are! Why does it take so long to open? It’s just clunky and feels like developers left the project 3 years ago

reviews.title: So Liberal
reviews.text: A “pregnant person” is a woman…. Just say woman.
